title: Home practical guide and safety card: habitat hunt
subject: Science
unit: Summer 1: Habitats and blocking sound (Blue Abyss and Can We Block Sound?)
source: Written for science/y4 lesson 26 (Home practical guide and safety card: habitat hunt (portal worksheet))
intro: Lesson 26: Habitats near home. A practical to do at home with an adult nearby. Read it all first.

practical.aim: To find animals and plants in a habitat near your home
safety: Stay away from roads and water
An adult knows what you are doing and is nearby
Clear a space and tidy up afterwards; wash your hands
method: Go out with an adult to a garden or park
Look under stones, logs and leaves, then put each one back gently
Look at the animals, but do not pick them up
Record each living thing and where you found it
Say what each one needs from its habitat (food, shelter, water)
Wash your hands when you come in

questions.q: A habitat gives food, water and...
Big question: why are woodlice under a damp log?
questions.a: The log gives the damp, dark shelter they need to survive.
